name: openspec-propose
title_zh: 需求一句话，设计·规格·任务三件套当场齐活
tagline_zh: 不用再对着空白文档发愁。把想法说清楚，它立刻产出提案所需的设计、规格和任务，让实现阶段直接开工。
tagline_en: Stop staring at a blank doc. Describe what you want, get a structured proposal with design, specs, and tasks.
desc_en: Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation.
why_zh: 把「想清楚」和「写下来」合并成一步，用结构化的产物倒逼你把需求说完整，省掉来回追问的环节。
why_en: It collapses thinking and writing into one pass, using structured outputs to force clarity and eliminate back-and-forth.
limit_zh: 只生成提案文档，不写代码、不跑测试、不做可行性验证。需求描述含糊时，产物会带着未决问题返回，需要你补充。
limit_en: Generates proposal docs only—no code, tests, or feasibility checks. Vague requests return with open questions for you to resolve.
title_en: One-line need → design, specs & tasks in one pass
